title: Techspressionist Salon Archive
description: A searchable, citable transcript archive of the Techspressionist Salon, a monthly gathering of artists working with technology, running since September 2020. Transcripts are timestamped and speaker-attributed; each segment links to the corresponding moment in the source recording. Generated by the pipeline in this repository from YouTube captions, Zoom transcripts, and the techspressionism.com site.
